subsubthemes.name: How far into the future can we predict?
subsubthemes.gist: Papers on forecasting multiple time steps ahead, dealing with the challenge that errors grow as predictions extend further into an uncertain future.

subsubthemes.name: Making predictions more trustworthy
subsubthemes.gist: Papers focused on reducing uncertainty and improving reliability of time series predictions through uncertainty quantification, robustness techniques, and rigorous evaluation methods.

subsubthemes.name: Predicting when patterns change
subsubthemes.gist: Papers addressing non-stationary data and concept drift, where the underlying patterns evolve over time and old patterns may not apply to new observations.

subsubthemes.name: Combining information across variables
subsubthemes.gist: Papers on multivariate forecasting that leverage relationships between multiple correlated time series to improve predictions beyond treating each series independently.

subsubthemes.name: Handling real-world messy data
subsubthemes.gist: Papers tackling irregular sampling, missing values, and incomplete observations that occur in real applications, making predictions more practical for imperfect data.
